source_state: working tree with JSON hybrid migration; not committed at packaging time
implemented: JSON resolver publishes package-owned document and escaped Context carrying original text
Three copy commands use QuickJS and the unified SDK without creating a WebView
Unescape opens the editor; helpers require matching Context and ordinary keyword search offers only Workspace
UI/background share private indentation through anywhere.storage
Workspace consumes unified Context events with launch ordering, deduplication and draft protection
Browser-independent token/UTF-8 processing preserves large integers, exponents, duplicate keys and escapes

checks.json_package_e2e: Real built package approval -> Context -> Action -> SDK -> QuickJS -> synthetic clipboard confirmation/cancellation; verifies UI routes, shared indent and exact tokens

resource_contract.runtime: on demand, existing 32 MiB / 250 ms job limits; no idle VM
resource_contract.rss_or_native_helper_measurement: not performed; resource caps are not App RSS measurements

native_gui.reason: Desktop inventory reported the Mac locked. Native UI acceptance and updating the installed plugin were not performed.

installation: App and plugin are separate artifacts; run Build 22+ and import JSON 0.6.0 through Settings to review the updated Context grants.
limitations: Background jobs remain in-process workers, not OS process isolation
No arbitrary filesystem, network or resident background monitor
No native GUI, physical IME or memory claim for this build; no GitHub Release
